product_hypercube.note: Q_0 = 'K_1 (one vertex, no edge, not the empty graph) and Q_(d+1) = 'K_2 □ Q_d on the nested ordinal/product carrier; 2^d vertices; isomorphic to tuple_hypercube d for every d, and Q_1 to K_2.

tuple_hypercube.note: Vertices are the d-bit tuples, two adjacent iff exactly one coordinate differs (tuple_hypercube_edgeP); 2^d vertices; Q_0 has one vertex and no edge; isomorphic to product_hypercube d for every d.
